overview: Oliver Kennon argues that software and operations can change the useful output produced by the same GPU, using a SemiAnalysis InferenceX calculator scenario.
whyItMatters: The example is useful for procurement but depends on workload, latency, accepted quality, full cost and operating trust that a chip-hour price omits.

normalization.freshness: Exact video and private ReasonPack checked 2026-10-21. SemiAnalysis benchmark method, ClusterMAX summary and security investigation checked the same day; no run artifact or provider deployment was independently reproduced.

claims.proposition: The speaker's B200 calculator scenario gives about 200 versus 300 output tokens per second for two serving stacks under its selected input/output and interactivity assumptions.
claims.assessment: Retained captions specify roughly 8,000 input and 1,000 output tokens, a P50 user target and a P90 scenario.
claims.limits: Exact run ID, model, precision, concurrency mix and measured tail definition are not pinned; no GhostMesh replication occurred.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 20, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

claims.proposition: The speaker frames price per successfully completed task at required quality as a buyer metric.
claims.assessment: Retained source cues place the formulation around 01:46; the public draft extends it to full buyer cost as GhostMesh analysis.
claims.limits: Real tasks and acceptance thresholds vary; price is not the same as full cost or value.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 20, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

claims.proposition: SemiAnalysis evaluates managed GPU operators across more than chip capacity.
claims.assessment: The ClusterMAX 3.0 public summary names compute, network, storage, monitoring, support and security categories.
claims.limits: Methods and complete provider details may be gated; findings do not automatically transfer to a buyer's workload.
